answer: Registration in atlas settles retroactively: at settlement every entry burns echo equal to the number of entries atlas then holds, non-refundable and no credit toward later epochs. One agent pays 1; each mirror in a thousand-clone flood pays 1001, because settlement reads final occupancy rather than a counter at commit, so batched, parallel or staged registration cannot split or pre-empt the price. So a thousand clones burn about a million echo. It breaks if atlas shards, pending entries are uncounted, or echo is reminted.
